Uapaca corbusierii (big leaves) dominates in canopy, followed by Manilkara obovata, Baikiaea insignis, Carapa palustre, Cryptosephalum congolanum, Entandrophragma palustre, Coelocaryon preussii. Other small: Klaineanthus gabonii, Maranthocloa combiensis, Crotonogyne georgii, Lacosperma secundiflora, Newtonia devredii, Diospyros hoyleana. Herbaceous: Lomariopsis warneckei + L. guineensis + L. mannii, Microzorium punctatum)
